canonicalRequirements.statement: The normal ledger-validator entrypoint, invoked without --source-map, must load governance/authority/GENESIS_IMPORT_SOURCE_MAP.json automatically.
The default source-map path is resolved below --root and never below the terminal working directory.
--source-map remains an explicit override with strict priority over the canonical default.
An invalid explicit override fails closed and never silently degrades to the canonical default map.
An absent or unparsable canonical default map produces a structured BLOCKING finding and a fail-closed exit; no resolution error is ever masked.
An absent external authority or an external authority hash mismatch still produces a structured failure once the default map is active.
Normal no-override ledger validation exits 0 with valid=true and zero findings against the pinned live repository.
OBS-R2-01 is closed only after executed I4 validation evidence exists; no closure on summary or intent.
This contract does not redefine, narrow, or extend the canonical GATE12 objective recorded in the pinned registry; the objective hash is bound and recalculated.
I4 closes as executed by the agent and pending independent audit; COMPLETE_CONFIRMED is not reachable through this mission.

positiveTests.name: 1. normal entry without --source-map activates the canonical default and passes
2. explicit valid override is preserved, relative and absolute
8. the result is identical from any terminal working directory
positiveTests.expected: identical report from five working directories; a decoy map beside the terminal cwd is ignored

negativeTests.name: 3. invalid explicit override fails closed and never falls back to the default
negativeTests.expected: exitCode=2, MISSING_GENESIS_IMPORT_SOURCE_MAP or INVALID_GENESIS_IMPORT_SOURCE_MAP, no default substitution

negativeTests.name: 4. absent canonical default map fails closed with a structured finding
5. unparsable canonical default map fails closed with a structured finding
6. absent external authority fails even with the default map active
7. external authority hash mismatch fails even with the default map active

reuseRules: CP00 repinning evidence is reusable while HEAD, origin/main, the ledger hash, and the bootstrap authority hash are unchanged.
The sandbox patch preflight is reusable while the patched validator bytes are unchanged.
invalidationRules: Any change to governance/state/GATE_STATUS_LEDGER.ndjson invalidates every executed validation in this revision.
Any change to governance/authority/GENESIS_IMPORT_SOURCE_MAP.json invalidates REQ-I4-01, REQ-I4-05, and REQ-I4-07 evidence.
Any change to governance/tools/validate-status-ledger.mjs after sealing invalidates the R0001 protected hashes.
Any change to the 14 adopted R4 files invalidates this revision.
forbiddenReplays: Subagent delegation of any part of this mission.

git add, git commit, git push, git reset, git restore, git checkout, git clean, git stash, git switch, git merge, git rebase, git cherry-pick, git apply, git am, git update-index, git rm, git mv, git fetch, git pull, git worktree.
Mutation of any of the 14 adopted R4 files.
Mutation of governance/sources/I4_BOOTSTRAP_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY.json or of the independent audits.
Mutation of any historical state revision.
Any write outside the eight authorizedPaths.
A second consumption of the single-use bootstrap authority.
Declaring I4 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED before a separate independent audit.
Creating, modifying, or making executable anything under the next gate directory tree.

closureConditions: node --check on the patched validator and on the I4 test file exits 0.
Normal no-override ledger validation exits 0 with valid=true and zero findings.
Explicit override validation exits 0 with valid=true and zero findings.
Every positive and hostile test in governance/tests/i4-default-source-map-activation.test.mjs passes with zero failures.
validate-gate-contract reports valid=true for R0001 and its pointer.
OBS-R2-01 is CLOSED with executed closure evidence only after all validations above are green.
The Git delta contains exactly one modified existing file and seven created files, all inside authorizedPaths, with zero staged, zero committed, and zero pushed changes.
The ledger, the 14 adopted R4 files, the bootstrap authority, and the independent audits are byte-invariant.
I4 is recorded as executed by the agent and pending independent audit, never as COMPLETE_CONFIRMED.
nextGateAuthorizationConditions: A separate independent audit session must reinspect this revision before any progression claim.
GATE13 is not authorized and not made executable by this mission or by the temporary bootstrap authority.
No next-gate execution contract, state, or directory tree is created by this mission.
The temporary bootstrap authority is single-use and becomes SUPERSEDED only on audited I4 closure.
